held.description: Explicit per-run hold; global pause is reported separately by PauseState.

explanation.description: Bounded explanation of the pinned admission decision or latest execution outcome.

versionId.description: Verified pre-commit collection version linked to the same plan; does not imply every field is undoable.

code.description: Returned once. Idempotent command replay returns null, matching existing credential issuance; issue a fresh grant if the initial response was lost.
